params.name: api_key
params.description: Your ValueSERP API key. Use "demo" for testing limited queries.

params.name: search_type
params.description: Must be set to "news".

params.name: q
params.description: The keyword or search query to use.

params.name: location
params.description: Geographic location for the search. Accepts location names (e.g., "manhattan,new york,united states") or GPS coordinates (e.g., "lat 43.437677,lon 3.8392765").

params.name: location_auto
params.description: When true, automatically updates gl and hl parameters based on the built-in location value. Defaults to true.

params.name: google_domain
params.description: The Google domain to use for the search.

params.name: gl
params.description: Determines the Google country to use for the query. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

params.name: hl
params.description: Determines the Google UI language to return results in. BCP-47 language code.

params.name: lr
params.description: Limits results to pages in the specified language.

params.name: cr
params.description: Limits results to pages from the specified country.

params.name: page
params.description: The results page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

params.name: max_page
params.description: Retrieve multiple result pages in a single API request. Specifies the maximum page number to retrieve.

params.name: safe
params.description: Safe search filter setting.

params.name: nfpr
params.description: Exclude auto-corrected spelling results. Set to 1 to exclude, 0 to include (default).

params.name: filter
params.description: Toggle similar/omitted result filters. 1 enables filtering (default), 0 disables it.

params.name: tbs
params.description: Custom Google TBS parameter value for advanced filtering.

params.name: uule
params.description: Custom Google UULE parameter to override the location.

params.name: time_period
params.description: Filter results by time period.

params.name: time_period_min
params.description: Custom time period start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Required when time_period=custom.

params.name: time_period_max
params.description: Custom time period end date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Required when time_period=custom.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort news results by relevance or date.

params.name: show_duplicates
params.description: Display duplicate results when sort_by=date is used.

params.name: exclude_if_modified
params.description: Exclude results from queries that were modified by Google.

items.docs: Retrieve real-time Google News results for a given keyword. Set search_type=news. Supports time period filtering, language, country, and sorting.
